state_a.description: The approved public benchmark specification has no executable harness, sealed fixture generator, backend packages, committed dependency locks, or cross-host receipts.

evidence.check: Read approved arms, invariants, fixtures, protocol, and publication requirements.
Workspace contains only production MemRight crates and no benchmark package.

state_b.description: One committed, isolated benchmark suite runs the same sealed workload on macOS and Windows, records exact dependencies and host identities, resumes safely, and rejects drift before results are accepted.

proof.expected: Exit 0; drift, resume, timeout, and atomic-output tests pass.
Exit 0; all arm receipts share fixture hash and exact arms pass parity.

authority.rule: Implement, validate, commit, and push the requested setup without including unrelated dirty changes.

safety.rule: Production defaults, prompt path, canonical DB, and private content remain unchanged; Stage 3 is excluded.

scope.rule: Standalone benchmark packages, deterministic fixtures, orchestration, tests, documentation, locks, and leaf/root Git delivery only.

quality.rule: Same canonical fixture hashes, exact-arm parity, pinned locks, raw results, atomic receipts, and verified remote SHAs.

cost.rule: No paid service; smoke is bounded to 256 rows and five queries before full runs.
